Method of Attack: File encryption ransomware that deletes shadow copies to prevent data recovery
Uses a ransom note demanding payment in Bitcoin (0.09981 BTC ~ $1,000)
Hosts payment portal on Tor network for anonymity
Uploads configuration file to receive link to chat-enabled website with ransom demands
Includes references to Vladimir Putin and a message to antivirus industry in code
Checks if infected system is in Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, or Ukraine and sends system data to attacker
Likely distributed via compromised remote desktop connections (RDP)
Excludes certain OS boot folders and file extensions from encryption
Indicators of Compromise: Payment portal hosted on Tor network
Code references to Vladimir Putin image with insulting caption
Base64 decoding key as message to antivirus industry
System data exfiltration including computer name, username, OS, and computer ID
Presence of 'isRU' check for certain countries
